document.title: KEUHKOSYÖPÄ SUOMESSA 2019–2023 – Rekisteripohjainen katsaus diagnostiikkaan, hoitopolkuihin ja hoidon laatuun
document.publisher: FICAN, Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitos, Suomen Syöpärekisteri

notes: Extracted the Parantava (curative-intent treatment) blocks of Taulukko 10 (collaborative areas and Koko maa) and Taulukko 11 (22 wellbeing services counties including City of Helsinki; collaborative area totals omitted from Taulukko 11 to avoid duplicating Taulukko 10), plus all national rows of Taulukko 7 (curative procedures 2019-2023 by year and total, omitting duplicate 2019-2023 total patient/curative counts already captured from Taulukko 10). Ahvenanmaa (93 cases) is included in national totals but excluded from regional results due to small counts, and 6 cases lacked municipality at diagnosis. Patients may receive multiple curative procedures in Taulukko 7.
